Personal Small Ground Drone (About the size of a Roadbike). A bike-sized construction drone, same range, 24 hours a charge. Treads (no Aimed Shots against it), LL/IR/UV camera and one tool: a backhoe (moves 5 tons of loose material), a jackhammer (Excellent Very Heavy Melee, 4m reach, +2d6 to cover), a small crane (Excellent Very Heavy Melee, 6m reach, lifts 5 tons; 2 MOVE while loaded) or a steamroller (Very Heavy Melee that always hits both legs as if Aimed, no penalty; 3 MOVE). Modes: Standby, Direct Control, Auto.

Cost: 5,000eb
MOVE: 4
HP: 35
CN: 10
Counter: DV17 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter
